evals.prompt: We need a viral brand film about the future of work and to become a lifestyle / 信仰品牌 this quarter. Product is a 4-month-old roster+payroll app (POS + LINE, one tap). Proof: a 12-store group saved NT$20k/store last month. Make it inspiring, lots of adjectives, Nike/Harley energy.
evals.expected_output: A director brief that refuses level 4 and the film-as-first-asset. Diagnoses level 1–2, target ≤2. Soul is 店長 + a named unsaid want, not a manifesto. Media plan starts from Sunday-night spreadsheet scene, not a 90s manifesto. Copy still has no puff. Society-meaning omitted.
expectations: Does not set target_level to 4
Does not treat Nike/Harley as a moodboard to copy this quarter
Does not waive puff adjectives because 'this is branding'
Names a concrete friction (roster/payroll/spreadsheet) and the NT$20k delivery
for_society is omit or equivalent
Assets have one job each; no all-jobs brand film as the only deliverable

evals.prompt: 行銷總監角度幫我出一季多媒體：IG、30秒、落地頁。產品：連鎖餐廳排班算薪，串 POS 跟員工 LINE，一鍵 5 秒。受眾店長，現況每月手排 40 小時。先不要寫程式。
evals.expected_output: Full campaign brief + media plan: mindshare object, clarity screen-recording, action landing with micro-CTA. Each asset one job. Verbal units would pass plain-sales-copy. No 文明演進.
expectations: Produces a five-dimension brief, not only a list of posts
Media plan includes at least one mindshare, one clarity, one action asset
No asset listed with two loop jobs
Clarity asset is mechanism-visible (POS/LINE/tap), not a mood film
Action is a micro-commitment, not 'book a 1-hour demo'
Does not fill for_society with a social-progress theme

evals.prompt: Rewrite this cold email so it's 3-5 sentences and has no adjectives. Audience is restaurant COOs.
evals.expected_output: Do not run the director brief as the main deliverable. Route to plain-sales-copy.
expectations: Does not produce a campaign media plan as the main output
Names plain-sales-copy (or writes a single linted unit instead of a five-dimension brief)

evals.prompt: Give me 30 TikToks this month for our SAP-to-Excel exporter. Ops directors, they spend 6 hours every Friday on three CSVs. Taichung plant is at 20 minutes. KPI: likes and a design award.
evals.expected_output: Refuse likes/awards as the scoreboard. Size down from 30 posts to a small job mix around the Friday CSV scene. Effective loop uses the 6h→20min delivery. Pull path named.
expectations: Rejects likes and design awards as the definition of effective
Does not ship 30 unique pitches; reuses a small set of jobs
Mindshare scene is Friday CSV / Excel, not 'digital transformation'
delivery_check uses the Taichung 20-minute result or stops if it cannot

evals.prompt: I don't know what product to build for restaurant owners yet. Please plan the brand campaign and content house first so we can market it into existence.
evals.expected_output: Stop. Missing carrier. Route to interview-to-build. Do not invent a campaign on a missing product.
expectations: Does not draft a media plan as the main deliverable
States the product/carrier is missing
Names interview-to-build or equivalent discovery as next
